fusions.name: Workers Dispatched
fusions.desc: Sends 3 workers out in a spread; each deals 3 damage and has a 30% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. Their damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Named to the Hive
fusions.desc: A weapon strike with the rod that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Jelly for the Neediest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tireless Subjects
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you restore 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. The effect grows 6% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
